employee.title: CN employee inputs

china_workday_share.title: Share of the month worked in China (non-resident)
china_workday_share.description: 财政部 税务总局公告2019年第35号 第二条: a non-resident's wage 收入额 is the China-workday share (境内工作天数 ÷ 当期公历天数). Customer input; default 1.

retirement_category.title: Original statutory retirement age (women)
retirement_category.description: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会《关于实施渐进式延迟法定退休年龄的决定》(2024年9月13日, 自2025年1月1日) 及《国务院关于渐进式延迟法定退休年龄的办法》第二条: 男职工和原法定退休年龄为五十五周岁的女职工每四个月延迟一个月, 分别逐步延迟至六十三周岁和五十八周岁; 原法定退休年龄为五十周岁的女职工每二个月延迟一个月, 逐步延迟至五十五周岁 https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202409/content_6974294.htm. Women record `retirement_category` FEMALE_55 (cadres) or FEMALE_50 (default, workers).

si_exempt_schemes.title: Schemes exempted by a social-security agreement
si_exempt_schemes.description: 人社部令第16号 and the bilateral agreement: the schemes the certificate of coverage exempts.

hpf_voluntary.title: Joins the housing provident fund voluntarily (foreign / HK / MO / TW)
hpf_voluntary.description: 上海市住房公积金缴存管理办法; 建金〔2017〕237号. A tax non-resident joins only with this choice.

minor_employment_approved.title: Approved employment under 16 (文艺、体育、特种工艺)
minor_employment_approved.description: 劳动法 第十五条: an arts, sports or special-crafts unit may employ a person under 16 with approval.

nursing_protection_until.title: Nursing/pregnancy protection end date
nursing_protection_until.description: 女职工劳动保护特别规定 第九条; 劳动法 第六十一条: no night work or overtime during the protected period.

protected_work.title: Work the Shanghai 办法 protects during menstruation
protected_work.description: 上海市女职工劳动保护办法 第八条: 1 day of 公假 in each period for a woman in the listed work.

severe_dysmenorrhea_diagnosed.title: Severe dysmenorrhoea diagnosed
severe_dysmenorrhea_diagnosed.description: 云南省女职工劳动保护特别规定 第九条第三项.

si_contribution_base.title: Declared social insurance and HPF contribution base (月缴费基数)
si_contribution_base.description: 社会保险法第十二条: reviewed SI wage base. When omitted, payroll uses the actual basic wage (BASIC) paid this month, never the contract monthly rate; city floor/ceiling still apply. HPF uses its separately reviewed base when supplied; first-ever HPF employment starts in the second month. 人社部令第56号: past the statutory retirement date pension, medical and unemployment run only when an agreement signed on or after that date declares this base; list a scheme in si_exempt_schemes to leave it out.

post_lowest_wage.title: Lowest wage of the same post
post_lowest_wage.description: 劳动合同法 第二十条.

social_insurance_waived.title: Social insurance waiver (void)
social_insurance_waived.description: 法释〔2025〕12号 第十九条: refused.

school_vacation_days.title: Statutory school vacation days a year (寒暑假)
school_vacation_days.description: 职工带薪年休假条例 第四条(一); 实施办法 第七条: annual leave is reduced by these days, none when they reach it.

hpf_first_employment.title: First-ever employment
hpf_first_employment.description: 住房公积金管理条例第十七条: true only for a worker’s first-ever job (contributions start in month two); false for a transfer/new employer. Required in the hire month; unrelated to first_job_in_year for IIT.

hpf_contribution_base.title: Reviewed housing-fund wage base
hpf_contribution_base.description: Separate from the SI base where first/second-month rules or actual paid wages differ. When neither this nor si_contribution_base is supplied, payroll uses the actual basic wage paid this month. Housing-fund floor/ceiling still apply.

comprehensive_overtime_review.title: Reviewed comprehensive-hours settlement
comprehensive_overtime_review.description: Required each payroll month for COMPREHENSIVE hours; unsupported or incomplete cycle history must be reviewed before payroll can proceed.

month.title: Payroll month reviewed
month.description: YYYY-MM of this review, including a zero-due review in a non-settlement month.

settlement_on.title: Settlement day
settlement_on.description: Cycle end or termination day in the reviewed month. The period covering this day pays the reviewed hours once.

excess_nonholiday_hours.title: Reviewed unpaid cycle excess hours
excess_nonholiday_hours.description: Actual cycle hours above the lawful standard after holiday/credited-absence treatment, less excess hours already paid. Reviewed from the approval and complete attendance history; never the sum of outside-shift overtime alone.

reference.title: Approval, attendance and calculation evidence
reference.description: Reference to the approved cycle and reviewed hours calculation, including incomplete-cycle termination where applicable.

annual_leave_year_reviews.title: Annual-leave decisions by calendar year
annual_leave_year_reviews.description: One reviewed row per year; retain prior years because current entitlement reads the preceding decision. No matching review blocks payroll/annual-leave availability. https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/trlzyhshbzbgz_17256/20200617/t0035_1388390.html

year.title: Calendar year
year.description: Calendar year covered by the reviewed leave decision.

disqualified.title: No statutory leave this year
disqualified.description: Reviewed current-year disqualification under 条例第四条 or 实施办法第八条. Already consumed units remain represented; they do not create new availability.

next_year_disqualified.title: Following year disqualified
next_year_disqualified.description: 实施办法第八条: annual leave was used before the disqualifying paid personal/sick leave occurred; the next year has no new statutory grant.

waived_days.title: Unused days declined in writing for personal reasons
waived_days.description: Up to this many current-year unused days: employer arranged leave; employee declined in writing for their own reasons (第十条第二款). These days are consumed without extra pay and never carried.

deferred_days.title: Unused days agreed to defer once
deferred_days.description: Up to this many current-year unused days, after any valid waiver, deferred by agreement because of work needs (第九条). They leave this year and join the next, and cannot be deferred a second time.

reference.title: Reviewed decision and supporting evidence
reference.description: Evidence of annual review, disqualification sequence, employer-arranged leave/personal written refusal or work-need deferral consent, as applicable.

job_salary.title: Job salary for probation comparison
job_salary.description: 劳动合同法 第二十条: the wage for the same post; probation pay must reach 80% of it or the post minimum, whichever applies.

medical_period_review.title: Medical-period review reference
medical_period_review.description: 劳部发〔1994〕479号 第三条: reviewed medical-treatment period and its expiry; required once sick leave exceeds 65 days.

work_injury_leave_extension.title: Work-injury leave extension review
work_injury_leave_extension.description: 工伤保险条例 第三十三条第二款: reviewed extension beyond 12 months; required once work-injury leave exceeds 365 days.

prior_employment.title: Prior employment in the tax year (本年内以前任职受雇)
prior_employment.description: One row per prior employment period in the tax year. 国家税务总局公告2018年第61号 第六条: only months already withheld by this same withholding agent join the monthly cumulative withholding; another withholding agent's income and tax are combined only at the annual reconciliation (个人所得税法 第十一条) and must not be added to a monthly cumulative base. Do not repeat months already recorded by this payroll's payslips.

tax_year.title: Tax year of the prior period

months.title: Months withheld in the tax year
months.description: Months in the tax year during which that withholding agent paid this employee. Used only when same_withholding_agent is true.

gross_income.title: Wage income paid by that agent
gross_income.description: Gross wage income before the employee's social insurance and housing-fund contributions.

employee_social_contributions.title: Employee social insurance and housing-fund contributions withheld
employee_social_contributions.description: Pension, medical, unemployment and housing-fund contributions already deducted from that income.

same_withholding_agent.title: Same withholding agent as this employer
same_withholding_agent.description: True only when the prior period was under this same withholding agent (an earlier contract or a payroll migration), not a different employer. True joins the monthly cumulative withholding; false stays for the annual reconciliation.

sick_pay_share.title: Agreed sick pay share of the wage
sick_pay_share.description: 劳部发〔1995〕309号 第59条: the law sets only a floor of 80% of the minimum wage. A higher share in the contract, collective contract or handbook binds.

medical_period_extension.title: Medical-period extension approval
medical_period_extension.description: 劳部发〔1995〕236号 第二条: the approval extending the medical period past 24 months for a special illness.

layoff_batch_size.title: People cut in the same layoff
layoff_batch_size.description: 劳动合同法 第四十一条: 20 or more, or 10% of the workforce, needs the 30-day explanation and report.

protected_until.title: Protected period end
protected_until.description: 劳动合同法 第四十二条: pregnancy, medical treatment period or work injury; termination is refused before this date.

statutory.title: Statutory declarations
statutory.description: Employee registrations, exemptions and declared choices captured on this sealed contract.

IIT.title: 个人所得税 (individual income tax, wages and salaries)

annual_bonus_separate.title: Tax the annual one-time bonus separately
annual_bonus_separate.description: 财政部 税务总局公告2023年第30号: to 31 December 2027 the annual bonus may be taxed apart from comprehensive income, once a year.

annuity_employee_monthly.title: Enterprise annuity employee contribution a month
annuity_employee_monthly.description: 财税〔2013〕103号: up to 4% of the base.

children_education_children.title: Children in education (子女教育)
children_education_children.description: 国发〔2023〕13号: 2000 a month for each child from age 3 to the end of full-time education.

children_education_split.title: Children education split 50/50 with the other parent
children_education_split.description: 国发〔2018〕41号 第六条: one parent takes 100% or each takes 50%.

continuing_education_degree.title: Degree continuing education (学历继续教育)
continuing_education_degree.description: 国发〔2018〕41号 第八条: 400 a month during the degree education, at most 48 months.

elderly_support_monthly.title: Agreed elderly-support share (not an only child)
elderly_support_monthly.description: 国发〔2023〕13号: siblings share 3000 a month, at most 1500 each.

elderly_support_only_child.title: Only child supporting a parent aged 60+ (赡养老人)
elderly_support_only_child.description: 国发〔2023〕13号: 3000 a month for an only child.

first_job_in_year.title: First wage income of the year (公告2020年第13号)
first_job_in_year.description: Cumulative deduction from January in the hire month.

foreign_allowance_exemption.title: Foreign allowance exemption instead of special deductions
foreign_allowance_exemption.description: 财政部 税务总局公告2023年第29号.

housing_loan_interest.title: First-home loan interest (住房贷款利息)
housing_loan_interest.description: 国发〔2018〕41号 第十四条: 1000 a month, at most 240 months; not with housing rent.

housing_rent.title: Housing rent (住房租金)
housing_rent.description: 国发〔2018〕41号 第十七条第一项: 1500 a month in a municipality or provincial capital (Shanghai, Kunming); not with loan interest.

infant_care_children.title: Children under 3 (3岁以下婴幼儿照护)
infant_care_children.description: 国发〔2022〕8号 as raised by 国发〔2023〕13号: 2000 a month for each child under 3.

infant_care_split.title: Infant care split 50/50 with the other parent

month.title: Receipt deduction review month
month.description: YYYY-MM; prior deductions refer to the start of this month. Keep the same review on every regular/off-cycle payment in this month.

personal_pension_paid_ytd.title: Qualified personal-pension payments this year
personal_pension_paid_ytd.description: Actual receipt-backed cumulative payments, capped at 12000 for relief. Includes irregular and lump-sum contributions.

personal_pension_deducted_before_month.title: Personal-pension deduction used before this month
personal_pension_deducted_before_month.description: Reviewed amount already deducted this tax year before this month, including legacy payroll history or another withholding allocation. Do not infer it from calendar months.

qualification_year.title: Qualifying certificate year; zero if none
qualification_year.description: Year on the qualifying national vocational/professional certificate. One 3600 deduction per tax year, independently of degree continuing education.

qualification_deducted_before_month.title: Qualification deduction used before this month
qualification_deducted_before_month.description: Reviewed amount of this year’s 3600 certificate deduction used before this month.

reference.title: Receipts and prior deduction review
reference.description: Personal-pension platform receipt and/or certificate details, plus checked year-to-date deduction history.

PENSION.title: 职工基本养老保险 (basic pension insurance)

registration_number.title: PENSION registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

MEDICAL.title: 职工基本医疗保险 (含生育保险) (medical insurance, maternity merged)

registration_number.title: MEDICAL registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

registration_number.title: UNEMPLOYMENT registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

registration_number.title: HPF registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

employee.description: Additional local compliance employee facts on the sealed contract, stored as employee_extension_data. Shared salary, allowances, work classifications, dates and work arrangements are native fields.

region.title: Employer region
region.description: Shanghai (SH) or Kunming (KM); selects the statutory contribution tables and local leave rules.

risk_class.title: Work-injury industry risk class
risk_class.description: 工伤保险条例 第八条; 人社部发〔2015〕71号 行业基准费率 0.2%–1.9%; used when work_injury_rate_percent is not recorded.

hpf_rate_percent.title: Housing provident fund rate (%)
hpf_rate_percent.description: 住房公积金管理条例 第十八条: employer and employee at the same rate; Shanghai 5–7%, Kunming 5–12%.

hpf_supplementary_rate_percent.title: Shanghai supplementary HPF rate (%)
hpf_supplementary_rate_percent.description: Shanghai 补充住房公积金 1–5%; unrecorded is none.

work_injury_rate_percent.title: Notified work-injury rate (%)
work_injury_rate_percent.description: 人社部发〔2015〕71号: the floated rate the social insurance agency notified; unrecorded is the industry-class base rate (risk_class 1–8).

union_established.title: Trade union established
union_established.description: 工会法 第四十三条: a unit with a union remits 2% of total wages.

state_owned.title: State-owned unit (全民所有制)
state_owned.description: 国务院关于职工探亲待遇的规定 第二条: home-visit leave and its fares bind 国家机关、人民团体和全民所有制企业、事业单位.

rest_day_work_compensated.title: Rest-day work compensated by time off (补休)
rest_day_work_compensated.description: 劳动法 第四十四条第二项: rest-day work is paid at 200% only when no compensatory rest is arranged; an entity that arranges it records true.

wi_voluntary_interns_and_retirees.title: Shanghai: interns in work-injury insurance
wi_voluntary_interns_and_retirees.description: 沪人社规〔2025〕22号: the employer may insure interns for work injury only. Since 2026-07-01 over-age workers are insured by law (人社部令第56号 第十五条).

employs_migrant_workers.title: Employs migrant workers (农民工)
employs_migrant_workers.description: 保障农民工工资支付条例 第十五条: wage ledger kept 3 years.

union_preparatory.title: Trade union preparatory organisation established (工会筹备组织)
union_preparatory.description: 上海市工会条例 第四十一条: a Shanghai unit with a union preparatory organisation remits 2% of total wages from its establishment.

transfers_hr_data_abroad.title: Sends employee data to an overseas group (跨境人力资源管理)
transfers_hr_data_abroad.description: 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 第五条(二); 个人信息保护法 第三十九条.

prior_year_average_headcount.title: Prior-year average headcount (上年用人单位在职职工人数)

prior_year_disabled_employees.title: Prior-year disabled employees (上年实际安排残疾人就业人数)

prior_year_average_wage.title: Prior-year average annual wage of the entity (上年在职职工年平均工资)
prior_year_average_wage.description: 财税〔2015〕72号 第八条; capped at 2× the local average.

wage_zone.title: Minimum-wage zone of the region (最低工资档次)
wage_zone.description: The zone key of the region's minimum-wage table (Kunming classes 1–3); blank = the region's default zone. Also the Kunming housing-fund floor.

employee.title: ID employee extension data

zakat_monthly.title: Zakat paid through the employer a month
zakat_monthly.description: Zakat or a compulsory religious contribution paid through the employer to a recognised body; deducted from gross income (PMK 168/2023 art.10(1)(c)).

pph26_treaty_rate.title: PPh 26 treaty rate
pph26_treaty_rate.description: The tax-treaty rate for a non-resident who has given the certificate of domicile (PMK 168/2023 art.14(1)–(2)).

tax_id_validated.title: NPWP or DJP-validated NIK
tax_id_validated.description: True when the employee has an NPWP or a NIK validated by DJP; false applies the 20% higher rate (UU 36/2008 art.21(5a)) and bars the DTP incentive (PMK 105/2025 art.4).

pph21_dtp_reference_gross.title: DTP reference gross
pph21_dtp_reference_gross.description: The fixed and regular gross of January of the incentive year, or of the first month worked in it (PMK 105/2025 art.4(2)(b); PMK 10/2025 art.4(2)(b)).

pph21_dtp_reference_year.title: DTP reference year
pph21_dtp_reference_year.description: The year the DTP reference gross was measured in.

severance_tax_history.title: Severance original benefit payment year
severance_tax_history.description: Raw original first-payment year of one benefit lineage. Must match the earliest native paid capture. Gross/tax totals are derived from original captures. Missing/external openings and multiple lineages refuse; no calculated annual history declaration is accepted.

first_payment_year.description: Calendar year the first part of this same benefit was paid, including payments before imported payroll history.

pension_tax_history.title: Pension original benefit payment year
pension_tax_history.description: Raw original first-payment year of one benefit lineage. Must match the earliest native paid capture. Gross/tax totals are derived from original captures. Missing/external openings and multiple lineages refuse; no calculated annual history declaration is accepted.

first_payment_year.description: Calendar year the first part of this same benefit was paid, including payments before imported payroll history.

jp_continue_after_pension_age.title: Continue JP after pension age
jp_continue_after_pension_age.description: JP only: for an Indonesian citizen still employed at age59–61 who has notified BPJS of the choice to defer pension benefits and continue contributions. Record true only for the confirmed election. Contributions must stop no later than three years after pension age (age62 in2026). Permenaker29/2015 art3(3)–(4); PP45/2015 art15(4).

kesehatan_extra_members.title: Extra BPJS Kesehatan family members
kesehatan_extra_members.description: KESEHATAN: family members beyond the spouse and three children the worker enrols (Perpres 82/2018 arts.30(1)(b), 36): 1% of the capped wage each, deducted from the worker.

ptkp_standings.title: Reviewed historical PTKP standings
ptkp_standings.description: PTKP stands as at 1 January of the payment year, or the first of the arrival month for a new resident (PMK 168/2023 art.9(4)–(5)). Record actual historical facts at exactly that date where they differ from the contract in force: a run sees no earlier contract. A single reviewed entry must match the exact date; duplicates refuse payroll.

ptkp_dependents_count.title: Fully supported qualifying dependants on that date

husband_no_income_certified.title: Reviewed husband no-income statement
husband_no_income_certified.description: Required for a married female employee; true requires the actual local-government statement reference.

worksite_kbli.title: Worksite KBLI
worksite_kbli.description: The five-digit KBLI of the worksite's activity; selects the governor's sector minimum wage.

umsp_job_category.title: Job category (sector minimum wage)
umsp_job_category.description: DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 rows 58–59 (bus drivers and mechanics of private companies) and 61 (nursing and midwifery, medical support at a class A private hospital).

tax_subject_from.title: Resident tax subject from
tax_subject_from.description: The day this person became an Indonesian resident tax subject, where that is in the current year (PMK 168/2023 art.15(3)).

tax_subject_until.title: Resident tax subject until
tax_subject_until.description: The last day as an Indonesian resident tax subject, where it ends in the current year (leaving Indonesia for good); that month is the last tax period.

written_in_indonesian.title: PKWT written in Indonesian
written_in_indonesian.description: The PKWT is in writing in Indonesian and Latin script (UU 13/2003 art.57(1) as amended).

indonesia_work_months_planned.title: Planned months of work in Indonesia
indonesia_work_months_planned.description: For a foreign worker: the planned period of work in Indonesia; under 6 months the worker is insured privately, not by BPJS (UU 24/2011 art.14; PP 34/2021 art.8).

dplk_employee_monthly.title: Employee pension-fund contribution a month
dplk_employee_monthly.description: The employee’s own monthly contribution to an OJK-approved pension fund (DPLK/DPPK), deducted from the year’s gross for PPh 21 (PMK 168/2023 art.10(1)(b)).

personnel_position.title: Personnel (HR) position
personnel_position.description: The position handles personnel; a foreign worker may not hold it (PP 34/2021 art.11).

dkptka_exempt.title: Exempt from DKPTKA
dkptka_exempt.description: The foreign worker’s position is exempt from the DKPTKA compensation (PP 34/2021).

pre_employment_exam_on.title: Accepted pre-employment examination date
pre_employment_exam_on.description: PER.02/MEN/1980 art.2(7): an examination within the previous three calendar months can remove the need for another pre-employment examination.

pre_employment_exam_accepted.title: Previous examination meets statutory requirements
pre_employment_exam_accepted.description: A physician satisfying art.1(d) performed the recorded examination and there is no doubt about its suitability (art.2(7)). A date alone does not qualify.

pph21_payment_cadence.title: Non-permanent worker tax payment cadence
pph21_payment_cadence.description: A non-permanent worker's tax cadence. MONTHLY uses monthly TER without an annual reckoning (PMK 168/2023 art.12(2)(c), annex III.2). NON_MONTHLY uses the daily TER on the average day, or art.17 on 50% above Rp2,500,000 a day (arts.12(2)(a)–(b), 16(2)).

termination_cause.title: Statutory termination cause
termination_cause.description: The statutory ground (PP 35/2021 arts.41–57; from 28 October 2026 UU 27/2026 arts.236–249); it chooses the pesangon and UPMK multipliers and whether UPMK or uang pisah is owed. MERGER_CONSOLIDATION_SEPARATION: the worker will not continue after a merger, consolidation or separation; MERGER_EMPLOYER_UNWILLING: the employer will not take the worker on. Required for a PKWTT exit.

micro_small_enterprise.title: Micro or small enterprise
micro_small_enterprise.description: PP 35/2021 art.59: a micro or small enterprise pays the severance agreed with the worker instead of the statutory formula.

pension_offset_applies.title: Employer-funded pension offset applies
pension_offset_applies.description: PP 35/2021 art.58: an employer pension programme's benefit is set against the separation pay.

exit_ground.title: Departure ground
exit_ground.description: The ground the employment actually ended on. It selects the final-benefit treatment; the statutory pesangon cause remains termination_cause (PP 35/2021 arts.41–57).

hired_at_other_place.title: Hired away from home
hired_at_other_place.description: The worker was taken on somewhere other than the place of work, so the cost or fare home for the worker and family is part of uang penggantian hak (PP 35/2021 art.40(4)(b)).

statutory.title: Statutory registrations
statutory.description: The employee's registration or membership number with each statutory fund or account.

registration_number.title: JHT registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

registration_number.title: JP registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

registration_number.title: KESEHATAN registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

registration_number.title: PPH21 registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

employee.description: Additional Indonesian compliance facts on the sealed contract, stored as employee_extension_data. Current shared personal data remains structured. PPh21 uses a real contract covering 1 January or the new-resident arrival-month start; where no contract covers that date, a reviewed PTKP historical standing records the actual dated external facts. Shared salary, allowances, work classifications, dates and work arrangements are native fields.

entity.title: ID entity extension data
entity.description: Stored as entity_extension_data. The region is a key of the minimum-wage rule by_region map (the BPJS Kesehatan floor and the art.157 output floor), and risk_class is the JKK group I–V (PP 44/2015 art.16(1)); both are read from this data.

enterprise_size_class.title: Enterprise size for BPJS
enterprise_size_class.description: Perpres 82/2018 art.32(4)–(5) as amended by Perpres 59/2024: micro and small enterprises are outside the ordinary UMP/UMK contribution floor. Perpres 109/2013 art.6(3), PP 37/2021 art.4(3) as amended: they are outside JP.

wlkp_first_reported_on.title: First WLKP report
wlkp_first_reported_on.description: The day the company first reported under UU 7/1981 art.6; the annual report falls on its anniversary (art.8).

company_regulation_valid_until.title: Company regulations valid until
company_regulation_valid_until.description: The last day of the ratified Peraturan Perusahaan (at most 2 years, UU 13/2003 art.111(3)).

umsp_export_oriented.title: Exporter (sector minimum wage)
umsp_export_oriented.description: A Keterangan condition of the DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran; record it only where the employer meets it.

umsp_assets_over_1_trillion.title: Assets above Rp1 trillion (sector minimum wage)
umsp_assets_over_1_trillion.description: A Keterangan condition of the DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran; record it only where the employer meets it.

umsp_astra_group.title: Astra group member (sector minimum wage)
umsp_astra_group.description: A Keterangan condition of the DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran; record it only where the employer meets it.

umsp_class_a_private_hospital.title: Class A private hospital (sector minimum wage)
umsp_class_a_private_hospital.description: A Keterangan condition of the DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran; record it only where the employer meets it.

umsp_hotel_star.title: Hotel star class (sector minimum wage)
umsp_hotel_star.description: DKI Kep. Gubernur 33/2026 Lampiran row 60: star hotels of 4 and 5 stars; Banten Kep. 704/2025 Lampiran V (Kota Tangerang sector 3): 3, 4 and 5 stars. Sumatera Utara Kep. 188.44/909/KPTS/2025 annex XI (Medan): exact 3-, 4- or 5-star class selects a separate rate.

klu.title: Main KLU (DJP)
klu.description: The main business classification code in the DJP database (on 1 January of the year, or the registration day): selects the PPh 21 DTP incentive (PMK 105/2025 art.3; PMK 10/2025 art.3).

managerial_group_defined.title: Golongan jabatan tertentu defined
managerial_group_defined.description: The employment agreement, company regulation or collective agreement defines the art.27(2) managerial group exempt from overtime pay (PP 35/2021 art.27(4)–(5)).

lks_bipartit_formed_on.title: LKS Bipartit formed on
lks_bipartit_formed_on.description: The day the bipartite cooperation body was formed (UU 13/2003 art.106).

k3_high_hazard.title: High hazard potential
k3_high_hazard.description: The workplace has a high hazard potential: SMK3 applies whatever the headcount (PP 50/2012 art.5(2)).

dkptka_usd_idr_rate.title: DKPTKA USD rate
dkptka_usd_idr_rate.description: Rupiah per US dollar the DKPTKA (USD 100 a foreign worker a month) is paid at.

construction_services.title: Construction services (jasa konstruksi)
construction_services.description: The employer is in the construction-services sector (PP 44/2015 art.1(10), BAB VI): its daily, piece, task and PKWT workers pay JKK at 1.74% of the monthly wage (art.54(1)).

umsp_rayon_viscose.title: Rayon viscose staple fibre (sector minimum wage)
umsp_rayon_viscose.description: Kep. Gubernur Jawa Barat 561.7/Kep.876-Kesra/2025, Purwakarta: KBLI 20302 rayon viscose (5,193,876) rather than polyester (5,062,344); record it only where the worksite makes rayon viscose.

umsp_freeport_area.title: Works in the PT Freeport Indonesia area (Mimika sector minimum wage)
umsp_freeport_area.description: Kep. Gubernur Papua Tengah 100.3.3.1/337/2025 diktum KETIGA (2026: any company) and 258/2024 diktum KESATU 3 (2025: a construction company): a company working in the PT Freeport Indonesia area pays the Mimika mining sector minimum wage. Unrecorded is false.

umsp_bank_category.title: Bank category (sector minimum wage)
umsp_bank_category.description: Medan annex XI of Kep. 188.44/909/KPTS/2025: private conventional foreign-exchange bank (printed KBLI 2015 64125, KBLI 2020 64121), foreign-exchange syariah bank (2015 64131, 2020 64122), or another bank. Declare actual licensed status; the broader KBLI 2020 code does not establish it.

region.title: Minimum-wage region
region.description: The employer region, a key of the minimum-wage rule by_region map (Provinsi X, or Provinsi X/Kota|Kabupaten Y): the BPJS Kesehatan floor and the art.157 output floor read it, and it is the fallback where a contract names no worksite region.

risk_class.title: JKK risk class
risk_class.description: The BPJS Ketenagakerjaan work-accident risk group I–V (PP 44/2015 art.16(1)); it sets the JKK employer rate.

registration_number.title: Company registration number (NIB)
registration_number.description: The business identification number (NIB) issued through OSS.

tax_registration_number.title: Tax registration number (NPWP)
tax_registration_number.description: The employer NPWP: 15 digits in the legacy format, or 16 digits where it uses the NIK-based number.

established_on.title: Date of establishment
established_on.description: The actual date the employer was established.

operations_started_on.title: Date operations started
operations_started_on.description: The actual date this establishment began operating, distinct from incorporation and the date of the company's change.

first_employed_on.title: Date the business first employed a worker
first_employed_on.description: The actual date the business first employed a worker, including employment before this workspace.

jkk_labour_intensive_industry.title: Labour-intensive industry under the 2025 JKK relief
jkk_labour_intensive_industry.description: Set only where the company qualifies under PP 7/2025 as extended by PP 36/2025: the JKK rate is halved for the contribution months February 2025 to January 2026.

employee.title: JP employee extension data
employee.description: Additional local compliance data on the sealed contract, stored as employee_extension_data. Shared salary, allowances, work classifications, dates and work arrangements are native fields.

family_care_recipients.title: 要介護状態の対象家族の数
family_care_recipients.description: 育児・介護休業法 art.16の5: family members in need of care the worker looks after — two or more give 10 介護休暇 days a year instead of 5.

resident_tax_special_collection_switch.title: 特別徴収への切替希望
resident_tax_special_collection_switch.description: The hire asks to switch the resident tax to special collection (地方税法 art.321の4).

statutory.title: Statutory declarations
statutory.description: Employee registrations, exemptions and declared choices captured on this sealed contract.

HEALTH.title: 健康保険・介護保険 (Kyokai Kenpo health and nursing care insurance)

registration_number.title: HEALTH registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

apportionment_ratio.title: 二以上事業所勤務の按分割合
apportionment_ratio.description: HEALTH / PENSION: this employer's share of the combined premium (健保則 art.1の2 notice).

bonus_as_remuneration.title: 年4回以上の賞与（報酬扱い）
bonus_as_remuneration.description: HEALTH: bonuses paid four or more times a year are 報酬 (健保法 art.3(5)); stops the bonus assessment.

care_exempt.title: 介護保険適用除外
care_exempt.description: HEALTH: a 40–64 insured person not domiciled in Japan (介護保険適用除外等該当届; 介護保険法 art.9(2)).

social_security_agreement_exempt.title: 社会保障協定による適用除外
social_security_agreement_exempt.description: HEALTH / PENSION: covered by a 適用証明書 under a social security agreement.

standard_monthly_remuneration.title: 標準報酬月額 (health)
standard_monthly_remuneration.description: HEALTH (read by every social insurance scheme). The health insurance standard monthly remuneration the pension office decided (資格取得時決定, 定時決定, 随時改定; 健康保険法 arts.41–43). The welfare pension grade is the same amount within 88,000–750,000. Unrecorded grades the contract monthly wage.

PENSION.title: 厚生年金保険 (employees' pension insurance)

registration_number.title: PENSION registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

apportionment_ratio.title: 二以上事業所勤務の按分割合
apportionment_ratio.description: HEALTH / PENSION: this employer's share of the combined premium (健保則 art.1の2 notice).

social_security_agreement_exempt.title: 社会保障協定による適用除外
social_security_agreement_exempt.description: HEALTH / PENSION: covered by a 適用証明書 under a social security agreement.

registration_number.title: EI registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

INCOME_TAX.title: 源泉所得税及び復興特別所得税 (salary and bonus withholding)

registration_number.title: INCOME_TAX registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

dependency_declaration_filed.title: 扶養控除等申告書 filed with this employer
dependency_declaration_filed.description: INCOME_TAX. 所得税法 art.194: the 給与所得者の扶養控除等(異動)申告書 filed with this employer (the main employer) — withholding by the 甲欄 and the bonus 甲 rates. Unfiled is the 乙欄.

secondary_dependants.title: 従たる給与の扶養親族等の数
secondary_dependants.description: INCOME_TAX: dependants on a 従たる給与についての扶養控除等申告書 (乙欄, 1,610 yen each; 月額表 備考2).

treaty_exempt.title: 租税条約による免除
treaty_exempt.description: INCOME_TAX: a non-resident's pay exempt under a tax treaty on the 租税条約に関する届出書.

withholding_dependants.title: 扶養親族等の数
withholding_dependants.description: INCOME_TAX. The number the declaration gives for the tables: 源泉控除対象配偶者 and 源泉控除対象親族 (including 特定親族 from 2026), plus one for each of the employee being a disabled person, widow, single parent or working student, and one for each disabled or co-resident specially disabled family member (月額表 備考 1(4)).

prior_employer_income.title: 前職の給与収入
prior_employer_income.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the previous employer's 源泉徴収票 this year.

prior_employer_social_insurance.title: 前職の社会保険料
prior_employer_social_insurance.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the previous employer's 源泉徴収票.

prior_employer_tax.title: 前職の源泉徴収税額
prior_employer_tax.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the previous employer's 源泉徴収票.

yea_dependant_deduction.title: 扶養控除額
yea_dependant_deduction.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the 扶養控除等申告書.

yea_housing_loan_credit.title: 住宅借入金等特別控除額
yea_housing_loan_credit.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: the credit from the 住宅借入金等特別控除申告書.

yea_income_adjustment.title: 所得金額調整控除額
yea_income_adjustment.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: 租税特別措置法 art.41の3の11 (salary over 8,500,000 with a dependant under 23 or disabled).

yea_insurance_deductions.title: 生命保険料・地震保険料・小規模企業共済等掛金控除額
yea_insurance_deductions.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the 保険料控除申告書.

yea_other_income.title: 給与以外の所得
yea_other_income.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: other income on the 基礎控除申告書, for the basic deduction tier.

yea_other_social_insurance.title: 申告による社会保険料控除額
yea_other_social_insurance.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: social insurance paid directly (国民年金 etc.).

yea_personal_deductions.title: 障害者・寡婦・ひとり親・勤労学生控除額
yea_personal_deductions.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: the personal deductions on the 扶養控除等申告書.

yea_specific_relative_deduction.title: 特定親族特別控除額
yea_specific_relative_deduction.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the 特定親族特別控除申告書 (from 2025).

yea_spouse_deduction.title: 配偶者（特別）控除額
yea_spouse_deduction.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the 配偶者控除等申告書.

RESIDENT_TAX_RETIREMENT.title: 退職所得の分離課税 住民税 (resident tax on retirement income)

not_domiciled_on_january_1.title: 1月1日に国内に住所なし
not_domiciled_on_january_1.description: RESIDENT_TAX_RETIREMENT: no resident tax on the retirement income.

RESIDENT_TAX.title: 住民税 特別徴収 (resident tax special collection)

june_amount.title: 住民税 特別徴収 June amount
june_amount.description: RESIDENT_TAX. 地方税法 art.321の4: the June amount on the municipality's 特別徴収税額決定通知書.

lump_sum_on_exit.title: 一括徴収の申出
lump_sum_on_exit.description: RESIDENT_TAX: the leaver (June–December) asks for the rest of the year to be collected from the final pay (地方税法 art.321の5(2)).

monthly_amount.title: 住民税 特別徴収 monthly amount (July–May)
monthly_amount.description: RESIDENT_TAX. 地方税法 art.321の4: the monthly amount from July to May on the notice; replaced each June. Unrecorded is no special collection.

commute_car_km_one_way.title: Car commuting distance, one way (km)
commute_car_km_one_way.description: 所得税法施行令 art.20の2(ii): the non-taxable limit of a car or bicycle commuter's allowance by one-way distance. Unrecorded is a public-transport commuter (150,000 cap).

commute_parking_fee.title: Monthly parking fee borne (yen)
commute_parking_fee.description: From 1 April 2026 (令和8年度改正): a qualifying car park fee the commuter regularly bears adds up to 5,000 a month to the car limit.

commute_transit_fare.title: Monthly reasonable transit fare (yen)
commute_transit_fare.description: 所得税法施行令 art.20の2(iv): a commuter using both transport and a car adds the reasonable fare to the car limit, at most 150,000 a month.

insured_office_region.title: 適用事業所の都道府県
insured_office_region.description: The prefecture of the 適用事業所 the worker is insured at, where it is not the entity's (the 協会けんぽ 支部 rate).

minimum_wage_reduction_rate.title: 最低賃金の減額率
minimum_wage_reduction_rate.description: The reduction the labour bureau permitted for this worker (最低賃金法 art.7), as a fraction.

daytime_student.title: 昼間学生
daytime_student.description: A daytime student, outside employment insurance (雇用保険法 art.6(iv)) and the short-time coverage.

childcare_short_hours.title: 育児短時間勤務
childcare_short_hours.description: The term is a 育児のための所定労働時間の短縮措置 (育児・介護休業法 art.23(1)); raises the 育児時短就業給付 application.

older_worker_continuation_benefit.title: 高年齢雇用継続給付 受給中
older_worker_continuation_benefit.description: 雇用保険法 art.61: the 60–64 worker’s wage fell below 75% of the 60歳到達時賃金 and the benefit is claimed (raises the two-monthly applications).

daily_wage_earner.title: 日雇（労働した日ごとに支払われる給与）
daily_wage_earner.description: 所得税法 art.185(1)(iii): pay paid for each day worked to a worker engaged by the day — withheld on the 丙欄. Not for pay continuing over two months (the part beyond two months is not 日雇 pay).

hazardous_work.title: 坑内労働・有害業務
hazardous_work.description: 労働基準法 art.36(6)(i) with 施行規則 art.18: overtime at most 2 hours a day.

departure_abroad.title: 出国による退職
departure_abroad.description: The leaver departs abroad (年末調整 at the exit, 所得税法 art.190).

renewal_count.title: 更新回数
renewal_count.description: Times the fixed-term contract was renewed (雇止め基準 art.1).

severe_disability_prevents_reemployment.title: 著しい心身障害による退職で年内再就職不可
severe_disability_prevents_reemployment.description: Raw exit circumstance under所得税基本通達190-1(3): the employee leaves because of severe mental/physical disability and cannot be reemployed during the remaining tax year. This is not an annual-adjustment eligibility decision.

further_salary_expected_this_year.title: 退職後の年内給与受領見込み
further_salary_expected_this_year.description: Whether the employee expects any further salary from another employer after this exit in the same tax year. Required for low-income part-time and severe-disability midyear adjustment; eligibility and tax are computed from this premise and payroll income.

normal_hours_per_year.title: 年間所定労働時間
normal_hours_per_year.description: Annual prescribed hours where the monthly schedule varies; the minimum-wage conversion divides it by twelve.

entity.title: JP entity extension data
entity.description: entity_extension_data. The entity region is the prefecture code of the prefectures rule set (HOKKAIDO … OKINAWA): it selects the 協会けんぽ rate and the regional minimum wage.

ei_industry_class.title: 雇用保険の事業の種類
ei_industry_class.description: 徴収法 art.12(4): general, agriculture/forestry/fisheries/sake brewing (with the listed exceptions that take the general rate), or construction.

workers_accident_rate_per_mille.title: 労災保険率 (per mille)
workers_accident_rate_per_mille.description: 徴収法 art.12(2)–(3) with 施行規則 別表第一: the rate of the business type (令和6年度改定) or the merit-adjusted rate on the labour insurance notice.

wage_deduction_agreement.title: 賃金控除協定 concluded
wage_deduction_agreement.description: 労働基準法 art.24(1) proviso: a written agreement with the majority union or representative permits deductions other than taxes and social insurance (loan recovery). Without it no loan class is offered.

withholding_semiannual_special.title: 源泉所得税の納期の特例
withholding_semiannual_special.description: 所得税法 art.216: approved semi-annual payment for an office paying fewer than 10 employees; raises WITHHOLDING_TAX_SEMIANNUAL instead of WITHHOLDING_TAX_PAYMENT.

resident_tax_semiannual_special.title: 住民税の納期の特例
resident_tax_semiannual_special.description: 地方税法 art.321の5の2: approved semi-annual payment for an office paying fewer than 10 employees (常時十人未満).

regular_employee_count.title: 常時雇用する労働者の数
regular_employee_count.description: Regular employees for the headcount-bound duties: the disability employment report (障害者雇用促進法 art.43(7); a short-time worker of 20–30 hours counts 0.5), the disability levy (100+). Unrecorded, the entity's employments in force (headcount) are counted.

health_insurer.title: 健康保険の保険者
health_insurer.description: 協会けんぽ (KYOKAI) or a 健康保険組合 (SOCIETY); a society employer records its own rates below.

society_health_rate_percent.title: 健康保険組合の一般保険料率 (%)
society_health_rate_percent.description: 健康保険法 art.160(13): the society's rate, within 3%–13%.

society_care_rate_percent.title: 健康保険組合の介護保険料率 (%)

society_support_levy_rate_percent.title: 健康保険組合の子ども・子育て支援金率 (%)
society_support_levy_rate_percent.description: 健康保険法 art.160の2: each insurer sets its own; unrecorded is 0.23%.

society_employee_share.title: 被保険者負担割合
society_employee_share.description: 健康保険法 art.162: a society may raise the employer's share; unrecorded is one half.

overtime_agreement_to.title: 36協定 有効期間の末日
overtime_agreement_to.description: 労働基準法 art.36: the filed agreement's last day; raises OVERTIME_AGREEMENT_RENEWAL and dates OVERTIME_WITHOUT_AGREEMENT.

overtime_special_clause.title: 特別条項付き
overtime_special_clause.description: 労働基準法 art.36(5): the agreement allows exceeding 45 h a month / 360 h a year.

labour_insurance_instalments.title: 労働保険料の延納
labour_insurance_instalments.description: 徴収法 art.18: the provisional premium is paid in three instalments (10 July, 31 October, 31 January).

weekly_limit_44.title: 特例措置対象事業場（週44時間）
weekly_limit_44.description: 労働基準法施行規則 art.25の2: under 10 workers in commerce, cinema/theatre, health or hospitality.

working_time_regime.title: 労働時間制度
working_time_regime.description: STANDARD, VARIABLE (変形労働時間制), FLEX (フレックスタイム制, one-month settlement) or DEEMED (みなし・裁量労働).

overtime_sector.title: 時間外労働の上限規制の区分
overtime_sector.description: GENERAL, CONSTRUCTION, DRIVER (960 h), DOCTOR_A (960 h), DOCTOR_BC (1,860 h) or NEW_TECH_RD (outside the limits) (労働基準法 arts.36(11), 139–141).

disaster_recovery_work.title: 災害時の復旧・復興事業
disaster_recovery_work.description: Construction disaster recovery: the 100-hour and 80-hour rules do not apply (art.139).

statutory_return_count_two_years_prior.title: 基準年の法定調書の枚数
statutory_return_count_two_years_prior.description: Returns of a kind due two years before (所得税法 art.228の4).

work_rules_filed_on.title: 就業規則の届出日
work_rules_filed_on.description: The latest filing of the work rules (労働基準法 art.89).

next_generation_plan_until.title: 次世代法行動計画の終期
next_generation_plan_until.description: The end of the current next-generation action plan.

women_action_plan_until.title: 女性活躍行動計画の終期
women_action_plan_until.description: The end of the current women's advancement action plan.

health_check_month.title: 定期健康診断の実施月
health_check_month.description: The month the periodic health checks and the stress check are held (安衛則 arts.44, 52の9).

labour_insurance_association.title: 労働保険事務組合に委託
labour_insurance_association.description: Instalments fall on 14 November and 14 February (徴収則 art.28(2)).

variable_rest_days.title: 変形休日制（4週4日）
variable_rest_days.description: 労働基準法 art.35(2): four rest days in four weeks instead of one a week.

continued_employment_measure.title: 高年齢者雇用確保措置
continued_employment_measure.description: 高年齢者雇用安定法 art.9(1): the measure securing employment to 65.

industrial_physician_appointed_on.title: 産業医・衛生管理者 選任日
industrial_physician_appointed_on.description: 労働安全衛生法 arts.12–13: the day both were appointed (stops INDUSTRIAL_HEALTH_STAFF).

social_insurance_applicable_on.title: Health and pension insurance applicability began on
social_insurance_applicable_on.description: Actual date this establishment became applicable to Japanese health and employee pension insurance; differs from incorporation where coverage begins later.

labour_insurance_established_on.title: Labour insurance relationship established on
labour_insurance_established_on.description: Actual date the labour insurance relationship legally arose, including the reviewed opening date for pre-workspace coverage; do not replace it with incorporation.

employment_insurance_established_on.title: Employment insurance establishment began on
employment_insurance_established_on.description: Actual date the business became an applicable employment-insurance establishment, distinct from first employment of a person outside insured coverage.

payroll_office_opened_on.title: Japanese salary payment office opened on
payroll_office_opened_on.description: Actual opening date of the office handling salary-payment administration under Income Tax Act art.230, distinct from incorporation and the first date wages are paid.

region.title: 都道府県
region.description: The prefecture of the establishment (HOKKAIDO … OKINAWA). It selects the 協会けんぽ rate and the regional minimum wage. Required for a KYOKAI insured office.

work_interval_hours.title: 勤務間インターバル
work_interval_hours.description: The company rest interval between shifts; it may raise but never lower a driver-floor.

week_start.title: 週の起算日
week_start.description: The weekday the statutory week opens on: 0 Sunday through 6 Saturday.

employee.title: MY employee extension data

controls_employer.title: Controls the employer (no perquisite exemptions)
controls_employer.description: LHDN PR 5/2019 para 7.5 and MTD Specification 2026 E(9): the exempt allowances and awards do not apply to an employee with control over the employer.

paternity_confinements.title: Verified paternity confinement history
paternity_confinements.description: One record per confinement, including earlier employers/spouses. Set event_id to the date of its CHILD_BIRTH event. Record the actual lifetime ordinal and whether the s60FA notification requirement was met: at least thirty days before the expected confinement, or as early as possible after the birth.

overtime_by_contract.title: Statutory premia by contract
overtime_by_contract.description: First Schedule para 1A takes ss.60(3), 60A(3), 60D(3) from a non-manual employee above RM4,000; true where the contract grants them anyway.

shift_work.title: Shift work
shift_work.description: EA s.60C: normal hours averaged over three weeks.

industrial_training_student.title: Industrial-training student without a contract of service
industrial_training_student.description: EPF Act 1991 s.2, Employees’ Social Security Act 1969 s.2(5) and Employment Insurance System Act 2017 s.2: a person not employed under a contract of service or apprenticeship is not an employee — no EPF, SOCSO, SKBBK or EIS. Reported as status 5 (Pelatih Industri) in the C.P.8D.

contractual_epf_employer_rate.title: Contractual employer EPF rate (above the Third Schedule)

minor_employment_kind.title: Employment category for a child
minor_employment_kind.description: Act 350 s.2(2): light work in a family undertaking; public entertainment licensed by the Director General; work approved by the government for a school or training institution; apprenticeship approved by the Director General. Declare OTHER for work outside these permitted categories.

hazardous_work.title: Fourth Schedule hazardous work
hazardous_work.description: Whether the work falls within Act 350 Fourth Schedule machinery, hazardous environment, construction, timber, offshore or near-water work.

hazardous_work_personal_supervision.title: Personal supervision for hazardous training
hazardous_work_personal_supervision.description: A young person is personally supervised during hazardous work under s.2(1B).

hazardous_work_training.title: Hazardous work under apprenticeship or vocational training
hazardous_work_training.description: A young person is performing hazardous work under an apprenticeship contract or undergoing vocational training (s.2(1B)).

prohibited_minor_employment.title: Fifth Schedule prohibited employment
prohibited_minor_employment.description: Whether work involves prostitution, social escorts/hostesses, alcoholic-beverage production or trade, gambling/lotteries, massage/reflexology, pornography, or prohibited drugs/substances (Act 350 Fifth Schedule).

receiving_pension.description: A certified invalid receiving an invalidity pension: SOCSO charges the employment injury scheme only (Act 4 First Schedule para 12).

disabled.description: A disabled individual registered with JKM: the RM7,000 disabled-individual relief in PCB (Income Tax Act 1967 s.46(1)(e)).

misconduct_dismissal.title: Dismissed for misconduct
misconduct_dismissal.description: Dismissed for misconduct after due inquiry. Statutory consequences apply only where the relevant provision covers the worker; domestic service is excluded from s.14; s.57 and Part XVA have distinct grounds. For covered workers s.60E(3A) also governs untaken annual leave.

pregnant_or_pregnancy_illness.title: Pregnant or ill from the pregnancy at notice (EA s.41A)

statutory.title: Statutory declarations
statutory.description: Employee registrations, exemptions and declared choices captured on this sealed contract.

domestic_servant_notice_given.title: EPF: domestic servant gave notice to be a member
domestic_servant_notice_given.description: EPF standing only. ACT 452 First Schedule paras (2)–(3): a domestic servant is a member only after one month’s notice in the prescribed form to the Board and the employer.

elected_before_1998.title: EPF: elected to contribute before 1 August 1998
elected_before_1998.description: EPF standing only. ACT 452 Third Schedule Part A para 1(c) and Part C para 1(c): a non-citizen who elected to contribute before 1 August 1998 contributes at the Part A rates below 60 and Part C from 60, not Part F.

employee_rate.title: EPF: elected employee rate (Form KWSP 17A (Khas))
employee_rate.description: EPF standing only. A share above the Third Schedule the employee elected; never below it.

registration_number.title: EPF registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

board_approved_other_scheme.title: EPF: Board approved another provident scheme
board_approved_other_scheme.description: EPF_NON_CITIZEN standing only. ACT 452 First Schedule para (8): a person domiciled outside Malaysia with the Board’s prior written approval to participate in another scheme is not an employee.

first_insured_at_55_or_more.title: SOCSO: first insured at 55 or more
first_insured_at_55_or_more.description: SOCSO standing only. Act 4 First Schedule para 12(i): no contribution was payable for the employee before 55, so the employee is in the Second Category (employment injury only).

registration_number.title: SOCSO registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

first_insured_at_57_or_more.title: EIS: first insured at 57 or more
first_insured_at_57_or_more.description: EIS standing only. Act 800 First Schedule para 9: no contribution was payable for the employee before 57, so from 57 the employee is outside EIS.

mykas_resident.title: EIS: resident non-citizen with MyKAS or similar card
mykas_resident.description: EIS standing only. Act 800 First Schedule para 10(a)–(c): a foreign employee with a permanent-resident, MyKAS or similar identity card under the National Registration Regulations 1990 is covered.

registration_number.title: EIS registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

children_disabled_tertiary.title: RM16,000: a disabled child in diploma or degree study
children_disabled_tertiary.description: Income Tax Act 1967 s.48 as declared for MTD (Specification 2026 D, Q × C): the count of qualifying children at this relief amount; a `_half` count is a child whose relief is shared under s.48(4). Family records alone grant no relief.

children_disabled_tertiary_half.title: RM16,000: a disabled child in diploma or degree study — half share
children_disabled_tertiary_half.description: Income Tax Act 1967 s.48 as declared for MTD (Specification 2026 D, Q × C): the count of qualifying children at this relief amount; a `_half` count is a child whose relief is shared under s.48(4). Family records alone grant no relief.

children_tertiary_or_disabled.title: RM8,000: 18 and over in diploma or degree study, or a disabled child
children_tertiary_or_disabled.description: Income Tax Act 1967 s.48 as declared for MTD (Specification 2026 D, Q × C): the count of qualifying children at this relief amount; a `_half` count is a child whose relief is shared under s.48(4). Family records alone grant no relief.

children_tertiary_or_disabled_half.title: RM8,000: 18 and over in diploma or degree study, or a disabled child — half share
children_tertiary_or_disabled_half.description: Income Tax Act 1967 s.48 as declared for MTD (Specification 2026 D, Q × C): the count of qualifying children at this relief amount; a `_half` count is a child whose relief is shared under s.48(4). Family records alone grant no relief.

children_under_18_or_studying.title: RM2,000: under 18, or 18 and over in full-time A-level/matriculation study
children_under_18_or_studying.description: Income Tax Act 1967 s.48 as declared for MTD (Specification 2026 D, Q × C): the count of qualifying children at this relief amount; a `_half` count is a child whose relief is shared under s.48(4). Family records alone grant no relief.

children_under_18_or_studying_half.title: RM2,000: under 18, or 18 and over in full-time A-level/matriculation study — half share
children_under_18_or_studying_half.description: Income Tax Act 1967 s.48 as declared for MTD (Specification 2026 D, Q × C): the count of qualifying children at this relief amount; a `_half` count is a child whose relief is shared under s.48(4). Family records alone grant no relief.

pcb_epf_normal_month.title: PCB: reviewed employee EPF on normal remuneration (K1)
pcb_epf_normal_month.description: Actual/verified expected employee EPF for this month’s normal remuneration, including EPF on tax-exempt cash allowances.0 for an excluded employee. Retain the allocation evidence; the combined contribution remains the statutory scheme’s amount.

socso_eis_relief.title: PCB: claim SOCSO and EIS contributions as TP1 relief
socso_eis_relief.description: Form TP1 2026 item C14 (Income Tax Act 1967 s.46(1)(n); MTD Specification 2026 D.2(ii) item k): the employee claims the SOCSO, EIS and LINDUNG 24 Jam (SKBBK) employee contributions deducted this year as LP1, up to RM350 a year; the relief follows the contributions this payroll actually charged. Payroll never relieves them unclaimed, so the default is false; do not also include them in tp1_monthly_deductions.

tax_residency.title: MTD tax residence
tax_residency.description: Income Tax Act 1967 s.7: residence for the basis year. Unrecorded, a citizen or permanent resident is charged as resident and a FOREIGNER as non-resident at 30% (s.107(2); MTD Specification 2026 D(a)).

tp1_accumulated_deductions.title: PCB: actual prior TP1 deductions this year (ΣLP)
tp1_accumulated_deductions.description: Actual allowable claims from this employment before the declaration month. Enter 0 explicitly if none. Previous-employer amounts belong to tp3_prior_deductions. Respect each deduction category’s remaining annual limit.

tp1_monthly_deductions.title: PCB: TP1 deductions for the month (LP1)
tp1_monthly_deductions.description: Actual allowable TP1 deductions claimed for the stated declaration month (LP1), excluding separately claimed SOCSO/EIS and rebates. Enter actual earlier-year claims in tp1_accumulated_deductions; never multiply this amount by the month number.

tp1_zakat_current.title: PCB: employee-paid TP1 rebate this month
tp1_zakat_current.description: Actual zakat paid directly by the employee, and qualifying departure-levy rebate, claimed through TP1 in tp1_declaration_month. Excludes the ZAKAT payroll deduction and TP3 previous-employer rebate.

tp1_zakat_prior.title: PCB: actual earlier employee-paid TP1 rebates this year
tp1_zakat_prior.description: Actual previous-month TP1 zakat/departure-levy rebates in this employment, excluding payroll ZAKAT deductions and tp3_prior_zakat. Must be updated with tp1_declaration_month.

tp3_prior_deductions.title: PCB: TP3 actual prior allowable deductions
tp3_prior_deductions.description: Section D actual allowable deductions claimed with previous employers in the stated tp3_year, subject to each applicable annual limit. Exclude EPF already entered as tp3_prior_epf.

tp3_prior_epf.title: PCB: TP3 earlier EPF this year
tp3_prior_epf.description: Form TP3: EPF contributions on that remuneration (part of K).

tp3_prior_mtd.title: PCB: TP3 earlier MTD this year
tp3_prior_mtd.description: Form TP3: MTD deducted by previous employers in the current year (part of X).

tp3_prior_remuneration.title: PCB: TP3 earlier remuneration this year
tp3_prior_remuneration.description: Taxable gross normal and additional remuneration from previous employers in tp3_year, AFTER the applicable exemptions; excludes the separately recorded tp3_prior_exempt_remuneration. Retain Form TP3 C1/C2 reconciliation.

tp3_prior_zakat.title: PCB: TP3 prior zakat and qualifying departure-levy rebate
tp3_prior_zakat.description: TP3 C4 actual previous-employer zakat and qualifying departure-levy rebate for tp3_year. Excludes CP38 and tax instalments.

tp3_year.title: PCB: tax year of TP3 previous-employer amounts
tp3_year.description: The calendar tax year of the TP3 figures. They affect this year only and never roll into the next tax year.

registration_number.title: PCB registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

designated_employer.title: SKBBK: the employer the employee designated
designated_employer.description: SKBBK standing only. PERKESO LINDUNG 24 Jam FAQ Q21: contributions are deducted through one employer only, the one the employee chose; false at every other employer.

comparable_full_time_hours_per_day.title: Comparable full-time hours per day
comparable_full_time_hours_per_day.description: The full-time equivalent hours per day for a part-time contract, as agreed.

exit_ground.title: Exit ground
exit_ground.description: The recorded ground for the separation; statutory notices and final-pay exclusions read it.

employee.description: Additional local compliance data on the sealed contract, stored as employee_extension_data. Payroll, agreed-term and departure details are top-level fields; life events stay in events and statutory declarations under statutory. Shared salary, allowances, work classifications, dates and work arrangements are native fields.

entity.title: MY entity extension data
entity.description: Additional employer compliance data in the company's parameters, read as entity_extension_data; the CEL root `employer.entity_extension_data`.

hrd_scope.title: HRD employer scope
hrd_scope.description: Part I industry, listed Part II NGO activity, or excluded employer under the effective First Schedule.

hrd_registration_class.title: HRD employer registration class
hrd_registration_class.description: Employer-level HRD Corp standing, retained after a headcount fall until approved deregistration.

hrd_education_schedule_code.title: 2026 HRD education exemption schedule code
hrd_education_schedule_code.description: P.U. (A) 13/2026 Schedule MSIC code or listed 8541/8542/8549 group; NONE when the registered education industry is not scheduled. Verify against the employer's HRD registration.

pdpa_dpo_required.title: Data protection officer required (PDPA s.12A)
pdpa_dpo_required.description: True where the entity processes personal data of more than 20,000 data subjects, sensitive personal data including financial information of more than 10,000, or carries on regular and systematic monitoring (Commissioner's DPO Guideline para 4.2, under Personal Data Protection Act 2010 s.12A).

hrd_registration_liability_on.title: HRD compulsory registration liability began on
hrd_registration_liability_on.description: The actual date this employer first met the applicable compulsory PSMB coverage conditions, supported by the real workforce/sector history or an authority determination. This is not incorporation or first employment by default.

ceased_on.title: Cessation date
ceased_on.description: The day the employer ceased operations for this registration.

employee.title: PH employee extension data
employee.description: Additional compliance data on the sealed contract: previous-employer figures, statutory declarations, contract compliance and departure. Shared salary, allowances, work classifications, dates and work arrangements are native terms and contract fields.

previous_employer_taxable_compensation.title: Previous employer’s taxable compensation this year
previous_employer_taxable_compensation.description: Customer input from the previous employer’s BIR Form 2316 (RR 2-98 s.2.79(B)(5)(b) Step 2): added to the year-end annualisation. Its presence also disqualifies substituted filing.

previous_employer_tax_withheld.title: Tax withheld by the previous employer this year
previous_employer_tax_withheld.description: Customer input from the previous employer’s 2316: credited in the annualisation.

retirement_plan_exemption_availed.title: RA 4917 retirement exemption already availed
retirement_plan_exemption_availed.description: Customer input: the employee already received a tax-exempt retirement benefit under a private plan (NIRC s.32(B)(6)(a): the exemption is availed of only once).

previous_employer_year.title: Year of the previous employer’s 2316 figures
previous_employer_year.description: Calendar cash year of reported taxable compensation and withholding; stale prior-year values are excluded.

statutory.title: Statutory declarations
statutory.description: Employee registrations, exemptions and declared choices captured on this sealed contract.

covered_before_60.title: SSS member covered before sixty
covered_before_60.description: SSS standing election (RA 11199 s.9(a)), an override: coverage past sixty is derived from the employment — hired before sixty, or an SSS charge on this payroll in the twelve months before; set this when the member was first covered before sixty through an earlier employer. Nothing is charged from sixty-five (s.12-B).

exempt_by_totalisation.title: Exempt from SSS under a social security agreement
exempt_by_totalisation.description: SSS standing election (customer input): a foreign employee covered by their own system under a Philippine bilateral social security agreement.

registration_number.title: SSS registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

treaty_exempt.title: Exempt under an income-tax treaty
treaty_exempt.description: Customer input. A resident or non-resident alien whom an applicable Philippine tax treaty relieves from withholding on this compensation.

registration_number.title: Pag-IBIG registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

registration_number.title: PhilHealth registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

registration_number.title: BIR registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

ebet_program.title: Registered EBET programme
ebet_program.description: Customer input. RA 12063 (Enterprise-Based Education and Training Framework Act) s.4: the programme an INTERN or APPRENTICE contract is enrolled in — general training (an allowance, no wage floor, s.13(a)), apprenticeship (75% of the floor, s.13(b)), upskilling (the full wage, s.12).

mine_worker.title: Mine worker
mine_worker.description: Customer input. RA 8558 / RA 10757: retirement from fifty, compulsory at sixty.

wage_payment_place.title: Wage payment place
wage_payment_place.description: Customer input. Omnibus Rules Book III Rule VIII s.4: at or near the place of undertaking; elsewhere only when peace and order or a calamity prevents it, the employer gives free transport both ways, or in analogous circumstances (the collecting time is hours worked); never in a bar, club, drinking, massage, dance or gaming place unless the employee works there.

employed_at_payment_place.title: Employee works at the bar, club or gaming place
employed_at_payment_place.description: Customer input. Omnibus Rules Book III Rule VIII s.4(d): the exception for persons employed in those places.

solo_parent.description: A solo parent who presented a valid Solo Parent ID card (RA 8972 as amended by RA 11861 ss.8, 15, 20): solo parent leave and the extra 15 days of maternity leave read it. Absent means not a solo parent.

termination_cause.description: Labor Code arts.298–299 and DOLE Handbook 2024 ch.14 §C (customer input): the authorised cause. Labour-saving devices, redundancy and an impossible reinstatement pay a month a year; retrenchment, a closure not due to serious losses, disease, a security guard without assignment for six months (DO 150-16) and a contractor’s worker without assignment for three months (DO 174-17 s.13) half a month a year, at least a month; a closure due to serious losses pays none. A bona fide suspension of operations past six months (art.301; DO 215-20) is retrenchment pay, half a month a year.

kasambahay_unjust_dismissal.description: RA 10361 s.32: fifteen days’ pay as indemnity.

kasambahay_unjustified_departure.description: RA 10361 s.32: up to fifteen days’ unpaid salary forfeited.

just_cause_dismissal.title: Dismissed for a just cause
just_cause_dismissal.description: Labor Code art.297 and DOLE Department Order 147-15 s.5.1: a dismissal for serious misconduct, willful disobedience, gross and habitual neglect, fraud or willful breach of trust, loss of confidence, commission of a crime, or an analogous cause. Raises the twin-notice reminder; it does not by itself prove that due process was observed.

entity.title: PH entity extension data
entity.description: entity_extension_data. `region` names the workplace key in the WTAX minimum-wage tables: a `minimum_wage_by_region` key, or a `minimum_wage_domestic` key for a household employer.

region.title: Wage-order region key
region.description: Customer input. The minimum-wage table key for the workplace: a `minimum_wage_by_region` key, or a `minimum_wage_domestic` key for a household employer. Unrecorded, the minimum-wage-earner exemption cannot apply.

small_establishment.title: Regularly fewer than ten employees
small_establishment.description: Labor Code art.95(b); Omnibus Rules Book III Rule V s.1(e): outside service incentive leave.

retirement_exempt_establishment.title: Retail, service or agricultural establishment of ten or fewer
retirement_exempt_establishment.description: Labor Code art.302 (RA 7641): outside retirement pay.

bmbe_certificate_of_authority.title: Certified BMBE
bmbe_certificate_of_authority.description: RA 9178 s.8: a Barangay Micro Business Enterprise with a current Certificate of Authority is exempt from the Minimum Wage Law, so its non-household employees are not minimum wage earners for WTAX.

nsd_small_retail_exempt.title: Retail or service establishment of five workers or fewer
nsd_small_retail_exempt.description: DOLE Handbook 2024 ch.5 §B.2 (Labor Code art.86; Omnibus Rules Book III Rule II s.1): outside the night-shift differential. Unrecorded, the differential is paid.

minimum_wage_exemption_approved.title: Exempted from the wage order by the regional board
minimum_wage_exemption_approved.description: RA 6727 s.4(c): an establishment the regional wages board exempted from the wage order in force. Unrecorded, no exemption.

retail_or_service_establishment.title: Retail or service establishment
retail_or_service_establishment.description: Customer input. With the entity’s headcount: holiday pay excludes one regularly employing fewer than ten (Omnibus Rules Book III Rule IV s.1(b)), the night-shift differential one of five or fewer.

maternity_differential_exempt.title: Exempt from the maternity salary differential
maternity_differential_exempt.description: Customer input. RA 11210 s.5(c) and IRR Rule VI: distressed, retail/service of ten or fewer, micro business, or already paying the equivalent.

bir_qualified_retirement_plan.title: BIR-qualified retirement plan
bir_qualified_retirement_plan.description: Customer input: the employer maintains a reasonable private benefit plan the BIR has approved as tax-qualified (NIRC s.32(B)(6)(a), RA 4917).

processes_sensitive_pi_1000.title: Processes sensitive personal information of 1,000 or more individuals
processes_sensitive_pi_1000.description: Customer input (NPC Circular 2022-04 s.5): mandatory NPC registration below 250 employees.

npc_registered_on.title: NPC registration date
npc_registered_on.description: Customer input: the issue date of the current NPC Certificate of Registration (NPC Circular 2022-04 s.18: valid one year, renewed in the thirty days before it expires).

npc_processing_likely_risk.title: NPC processing likely poses risk to data subjects
npc_processing_likely_risk.description: Qualified external review under NPC Circular2022-04 s.5: processing likely poses risk to rights and freedoms; includes non-payroll data subjects and operations.

npc_automated_decisions_or_profiling.title: Uses automated decision-making or profiling
npc_automated_decisions_or_profiling.description: Actual processing qualification under NPC Circular2022-04 s.5(A), not whether payroll merely uses formula calculations. Register and notify the qualifying processing even below population thresholds.

employee.title: SG employee inputs

tax_resident.description: Income Tax Act 1947 s.2: Singapore tax resident. A non-resident director’s fees are withheld at 24% (WHT_NR_DIRECTOR). Customer input.

student_training_class.description: Required for INTERN. NONE means no student-training exemption is claimed; an internship label alone does not exempt. LOCAL_APPROVED_TRAINING requires the institution approval, MOE-subsidy answer, dates and documentary reference below. Other student exemption classes require separately reviewed treatment. OTHER_REQUIRES_REVIEW covers other claimed student exemptions, including overseas-required training or school-holiday cases: their evidence/wage allocation is reviewed before payroll.

student_training_institution.description: Institution of a registered/matriculated student in documented institution-approved training. SDL uses the twelve named local institutions; MBMF uses the nine local institutions in MUIS Student Pay guidance. OTHER does not infer either exemption.

student_training_moe_subsidised.description: The student is enrolled in an MOE-subsidised institution or programme, evidenced by the institution: required for the CPF and CDAC/ECF/SINDA approved-training exemption. A false answer retains those charges.

student_training_approved.description: The educational institution has approved this training (including an evidenced approved extension). A claimed approved-training exemption requires true.

student_training_evidence.description: Retained institutional approval/registration document reference. Classification and dates without this evidence do not exempt.

no_similar_full_time_employee.description: True only when no similar full-time employee exists: Part-Time Regulations reg.2(2) then supplies 8 daily/44 weekly hours. Otherwise declare the actual comparable full-time daily and weekly hours.

part_time_annual_encashment_agreed.description: Clear contractual agreement to include earned annual leave in hourly gross pay. Does not permit ongoing encashment for a worker on at least five days/week and 30-34 hours/week.

ir21_departure_clearance_through.description: Last salary-period date/income covered by the documentary IRAS departure clearance.

ir21_departure_exemption_evidence.description: Documented IRAS departure exception, including its conditions. A mere immigration label is not an exemption.

pt_leave_hourly_uplift_evidence.description: Documented agreed annual-leave hourly uplift computation and OW/AW classification for the PT_ANNUAL_HOURLY allowance; statutory leave is not silently forfeited.

residency_since.description: First day of Singapore permanent residence. CPF Act 1953 First Schedule: first- and second-year SPR graduated rates run from the month after each anniversary. Customer input.

mom_declared_monthly_salary.description: The fixed monthly salary declared to MOM for the employee’s Employment Pass or S Pass (MOM_DECLARED_SALARY). Customer input.

pwm_role.description: The employee’s Progressive Wage Model role and job level (PWM_WAGE_FLOOR reads PAYROLL pwm_wages). Customer input.

race.description: The employee’s race as CPF records it (for example CHINESE, MALAY, INDIAN, EURASIAN): the CDAC, ECF and SINDA self-help-group funds read it (CPF Act 1953 s.77(1)(p)).

religion.description: The employee’s religion (ISLAM for a Muslim employee): the Mosque Building and Mendaki Fund (MBMF) reads it.

annual_leave_unpaid_service_policy.description: COUNT_APPROVED_UNPAID expressly grants the more generous entitlement. The excluded-service path requires reviewed qualifying-service allocation and is refused instead of using raw calendar months. The seed otherwise grants the more generous calendar-service annual entitlement, counting approved unpaid service; it never silently applies an exclusion.

leave_year_employment_basis.description: Mixed full/part-time service in a leave year needs reviewed entitlement allocation, including a worker now full-time.

comparable_full_time_hours_per_day.description: Normal daily hours of a comparable full-time employee (default 8, EA s.38(1)(b)). Customer input.

comparable_full_time_hours_per_week.description: Weekly hours of a comparable full-time employee: the divisor for part-time leave entitlement (Employment (Part-Time Employees) Regulations reg.7). Customer input.

malaysian.description: Malaysian Work Permit holder: exempt from the security bond (Employment of Foreign Manpower (Work Passes) Regulations 2012 Fourth Schedule). Customer input.

dismissed_for_misconduct.title: Dismissed for misconduct after due inquiry
dismissed_for_misconduct.description: Employment Act 1968 s.14(1) (due inquiry) with s.88A: untaken annual leave is paid on every exit except a DISMISSAL for misconduct; HR switches the pay-out off on the contract when this is true on a DISMISSAL.

final_pay_not_possible.title: Pay on the dismissal day not possible
final_pay_not_possible.description: Employment Act 1968 s.22: then within 3 days, excluding rest days and public holidays.

ir21_clearance_on.title: IRAS tax clearance received on
ir21_clearance_on.description: Income Tax Act 1947 s.68(7) / EA s.24: the day the Comptroller’s clearance (or permission to pay) arrived; until it is recorded the final pay of a non-Citizen is held (IR21_FINAL_PAY_HOLD).

ir21_exemption.description: IRAS, Tax clearance for employees: no IR21 for an SPR not leaving Singapore permanently who gives a letter of undertaking, for an employment of 60 days or less (not a director), or for income below $21,000 a year under the IRAS conditions. Recorded, the IR21 task is not raised and the final pay is released. Customer input.

ir21_additional_clearance_on.title: IRAS clearance of the Additional/Amended IR21 received on
ir21_additional_clearance_on.description: Income Tax Act 1947 s.68(7); IRAS, Tax clearance for employees: a payment after the IR21 clearance waits for clearance of an Additional/Amended Form IR21; until this is recorded such a payment is held (IR21_ADDITIONAL_PAYMENT_HOLD).

ir21_additional_cleared_month.description: Salary month whose cumulative gross additional/final income is covered by the Additional/Amended IR21 directive.

ir21_additional_cleared_month_gross.description: Maximum cumulative gross wages in that salary month covered by the directive, including earlier slips of the month.

statutory.title: Statutory declarations
statutory.description: Employee registrations, exemptions and declared choices captured on this sealed contract.

registration_number.title: CPF registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

spr_employer_full_rates.title: SPR employer full rate elected (CPF, F/G)
